name: Park Hyatt Bangkok
positioning: Contemporary city hotel above the Central Embassy mall in Bangkok, with direct access to the BTS Skytrain, natural materials with Thai accents and a Penthouse bar and grill
best_for: Travelers who want a central Bangkok base linked to a mall and the BTS Skytrain
Guests who enjoy cocktail bars, live jazz and a steakhouse night out without leaving the hotel

facts.text: The hotel has direct access to the Central Embassy mall and Ploenchit station on the BTS Skytrain.
The pool is a saltwater pool with an infinity-edge lap-swimming section.
The spa is PANPURI WELLNESS, which offers organic treatments.
The gym has cardiovascular, strength and weight-training equipment by Technogym.
Room interiors use calming natural materials with Thai accents.
Bathrooms have a separate soaking bathtub and rain shower, with Le Labo amenities.
Penthouse Bar + Grill offers a New York-inspired evening of live entertainment, cocktails and classic steakhouse dining.
At Penthouse Grill, meat and seafood are prepared over organic charcoal.
Penthouse Cocktail Bar has live jazz from Wednesday to Sunday.
Embassy Room La Marina serves Italian cuisine inspired by Italy's coastal regions.
The Living Room serves International and Thai comfort food, loose-leaf tea and barista-made coffee.
An airport fast track service escorts guests through the priority diplomatic immigration line.

highlights.text: The hotel's meeting and event venues were designed by Yabu Pushelberg.
Penthouse Cocktail Bar has a vintage-motoring aesthetic and double-height ceilings.
The hotel holds 2 Michelin Keys in The MICHELIN Guide Hotels for 2024 to 2026.
The Rooftop Bar serves interactive cocktail experiences against Bangkok's skyline.

considerations.text: Spa experiences are not operated by Park Hyatt Bangkok and are not eligible for World of Hyatt points.
The Executive Retreat at The Park is included with premium and specialty suites; for other room categories it is an optional package.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's exclusivity.
